name: Cisco ASA — VPN Credential Brute Force
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "109006"
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count() as fails,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       count_distinct(xdm.source.user.username) as targeted_users
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter fails >= 25
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, users
description: Many 109006 auth failures from a single IP against the VPN gateway.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — VPN Credential Brute Force
